description: Official OL character and NPC card artwork for the Shanhe desktop UI. Local troop bindings reuse only the source NPC's visual role; they do not turn locally authored rules, stats or faction labels into original NPC definitions.
rendererEvidence: q6t.getSeatSkinUrl resolves an explicit generalskin through the normal skin table first and the PVE skin table second. Without generalskin it resolves the exact character default avatar; no name-based skin inference is used.
kJt.initPveSkin reads root.pveskin into hA records.
hA.SkinSeatUrl combines N2t.SeatImgUrl, seatpic and the PNG extension. N2t.SeatImgUrl is general/seat/static/.
Ps.makeUpRootResouceToUrl uses res/runtime/pc/ for the desktop client.
An NPC without a skin override uses the character avatar ID. Source archer4409 has class GongBing and no AvatarUseId override.

Generic commander4872 has class ShiBing72 and no AvatarUseId or AvatarUseId1. The frozen skin table contains no registered normal or PVE skin binding for 4872 itself. Its default card therefore uses generalface_4872; the Dong Min skin1000377 remains a separate per-encounter override.

For the fifteen source characters in groups2642/2650/2661/2674/2679/2683, each General row has no generalskin and each Character row has neither AvatarUseId nor AvatarUseId1. Re.InitData uses needVersion||0; all fifteen omit that field, and IsMysticalGeneral tests LOG_VERSION<needVersion. The frozen desktop LOG_VERSION40303 therefore does not select the9999 fallback. Their own ItemID is the exact default avatar.

The eight opening companions are identified through Tactics.strpra -> General.generalgroup -> General.generalskin -> root.pveskin, with General.spell IDs checked against cha_spell. The generic carrier name in character.sgs alone does not identify a companion. MGt.UpdateRogueGeneral also applies the selected PVE SkinHeadUrl for the original companion HUD avatar.
General abbreviation d=generalskin; h=growdouble. None of these five matched General rows supplies d.
All five exact Character records omit au/AvatarUseId,av/AvatarUseId1 and needVersion. Re.InitData uses needVersion||0 and frozen LOG_VERSION40303 does not select mystical9999 fallback.

The verified desktop default-avatar chain returns each Character.ItemID, then general/seat/static/generalface_<ItemID>.png. Normal catalog big art, encounter display names and h=100 are not avatar selectors.
q6t.getSeatSkinUrl first resolves a declared normal skin with kJt.GetGeneralSkinBySkinID, then a PVE skin with GetPVEAISkinVoById, and otherwise follows the declared Character GeneralSeatImg.
kJt.initGeneralSkin reads generalskin.items.item with root.abbreviation aliases; kJt.initPveSkin reads root.pveskin. The two tables are not interchangeable.
$At.NewSkinJudge maps ab to newSkinJudge. gCt.JUDGESKIN_TRIPLE_SPECIAL=3. IsManyStateDyskin is true for this triple-state skin.

Gjt.SetGeneralCard(t,60501) calls SetSkin. SetSkin writes generalCard.JueXingState=h||1 before loadStatic. loadStatic uses SkinSeatUrlJueXing(1) for a multistate skin; $At builds general/seat/static/60501_1.png.
q6t stage-flip uses the normal SkinSeatUrl60501.png; HTTP and actual RGBA comparison proves it is pixel-identical to the initial seat state while encoded SHA differs.
193 has no avatar or version override. The default identity is193, not another LvBu variant.
Four elephant General rows independently declare d1000001. Their hide1/startChapter markers remain evidence rather than being flattened into opening visibility.

companionSelectionEvidence.scope: The second pool component is recorded verbatim as sourcePoolParameter. No equal-probability claim is made, and no pool parameter, gameplay definition or selection rule is changed by these artwork bindings.

twoStageArtworkEvidence.identityBoundary: The first and second stages have separate source members, skins and skill definitions. Reusing1000367 for Zhang Niu Jiao is proved by the explicit PVE skin selection, even though source2656 uses the same image for a different NPC. No source carrier, display-name or family-prefix mapping is applied. Other Zhang Yan groups, including ordinary character581 and encounters selecting skin1000327, are outside these bindings.
twoStageArtworkEvidence.scope: This records the current UI artwork and runtime-selection evidence only; it does not change difficulty gates, stages, source data, gameplay definitions or save/content versions.

copyPolicy: Each imported file is a byte-for-byte copy of the official standalone PNG. Source dimensions and pixels are unchanged; no crop, resize, recoloring, generated artwork, or substitution with a named general was performed.
bindingPolicy: bindingCandidates are explicit, complete runtime GeneralId whitelists for these imported images. They are not prefix rules or global aliases for a numeric source carrier such as4871 or4861, which can have different names and PVE skins in other encounters.
